lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance pixel clusters are organized into a grid-like array starting posterior to the fifth gill slit, following the longitudinal trajectories of the lateral carinae toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae, creating a coordinate-like grid where high-luminance blobs are localized within the resulting quadrangular cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp linear highlight on the dorsal edge and a parallel shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the primary body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs within the first dorsal fin silhouette, with clusters most visible at the anterior base and becoming less distinct toward the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally high density of small, high-luminance spots on the leading edge and dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin compared to the primary flank patterning.
